description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the ImageController class in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It tests image handling responses, including content retrieval and handling of HTTP cache headers.

classes.name: ImageControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ImageController's image handling functionalities.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures by loading theme configuration data before any tests are run.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Tests the handle method of ImageController for correct image response and cache handling.

methods.name: dataProviderForController
methods.description: Provides test data for different image names, sizes, and expected ETags.
